answer: Weight keys by random-walk trust: walks start at 20 long-standing 'beacon' nodes, and a key earns the share of 10,000 walks that end on it. A 1,000-key farm joined to honest nodes through only 5 vouch edges (its single inlet) gets about 5 edges' worth of walks, so each fake earns ~1/200 of an honest key. Weakness: bought vouches. Fix: a vouch locks 500 tokens of 'jade' stake, slashed 50% if the vouched key is flagged.
